facts.fact: Niger's and Chad's communications ministers signed a memorandum of understanding on updating and implementing the cross-border interconnection of the Trans-Saharan Fibre Optic Backbone (DTS/FO), and instructed Nigertelecoms and Safitel Chad to open technical talks (ANP report; its body gives a mistaken July date, the dateline reads 19 June 2025).

The ministers reported Niger's civil works at 97% with 48 km of fibre left to reach the Chad border, and Chad's DTS/FO component at 42.78% with Safitel's cable already at the Niger border; interconnection was expected at the end of August 2025.

systems.owner: Niger and Chad governments; operators Nigertelecoms and Safitel Chad
